items.key: 1994/95 total kg/tree at age 14: HLH Mauritius 87.87, Red McLean 30.58, Fay Zee Siu 27.92. Marketable weights are respectively 77.87, 28.42 and 23.38 kg/tree. items.key: Calculated orchard-average equivalent using the KZN guide's likely production of 50 t/ha and midpoint planting spacings: cool KZN Midlands, 5.75 x 2.75 m, about 79 kg/tree; hot areas, 7.5 x 3.5 m, about 131 kg/tree. Calculation: 50,000 kg/ha x m²/tree / 10,000 m²/ha. These values are derived, not measured individual-tree yields. The spread reflects spacing, not varieties or a production-by-age curve. Confirm local orchard yield and actual spacing before using this reference.

Confirm local orchard yield and actual spacing before using this indicator.

items.key: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands bioclimatic group 2), with intensive irrigation and nutrition. Age 3: 10,000 kg/ha; age 6: 20,000 kg/ha; sustainable average about 22,500 kg/ha. Same-study density permits equivalents of 50 kg/tree at age 3 and 100 kg/tree at age 6; there is no reference for every intermediate age. These orchard benchmarks are conditional on good resources, comparable climate and timely orchard management, including Phytophthora control and thinning; do not auto-fill farm quantities.
items.draft: I-Hass kwi-Duke 7, ekuqaleni imithi eyi-200/ha eBruyns Hill (iqela lemozulu yendalo lesi-2 laseNatal Midlands), kunye nokunkcenkceshela nokondla okunzulu. Iminyaka emi-3: 10,000 kg/ha; iminyaka emi-6: 20,000 kg/ha; umndilili oqhubekayo malunga ne-22,500 kg/ha. Ubuninzi bophando olufanayo bugunyaza ezilinganayo ne-50 kg/umthi kwiminyaka emi-3 kunye ne-100 kg/umthi kwiminyaka emi-6; akukho sisalathiso kuyo yonke iminyaka ephakathi. Ezi zalathiso zesitiya ziphantsi kwezixhobo ezilungileyo, imozulu efanayo nolawulo lwesitiya ngexesha, kubandakanya ulawulo lwe-Phytophthora nokucutha; ungazaleli ngokuzenzekelayo amanani efama.
items.backtranslation: Hass on Duke 7, initially 200 trees/ha at Bruyns Hill (Natal Midlands climate group 2), with irrigation and deep feeding. 3 years: 10,000 kg/ha; 6 years: 20,000 kg/ha; continuing average about 22,500 kg/ha. items.key: The discussion explicitly includes S. undulata among edible dried ripe currant fruits and traditional fermentation uses. Its host article species calendar is not transferred to S. undulata.

items.key: The human food product is young leaves. Berries described as bird/bat food are not promoted to a human fruit harvest. No leaf cutting age, exact months or household leaf kg is given.
items.draft: Imveliso yokutya yabantu yamagqabi amatsha. Amaberry achazwa njengokutya kweentaka/kweengcuka alikhuthazwa njengesivuno seziqhamo sabantu. Akukho budala bokusika amagqabi, inyanga ezichanekileyo okanye kg yamagqabi ekhaya enikeziweyo.
items.backtranslation: Human food product of fresh leaves. Berries described as food of birds/mongoose are not encouraged as human fruit harvest. No age of cutting leaves, exact months or kg of home leaves given.

items.key: The museum lists M. nigra as cultivated in southern Africa and distinguishes naturalised Morus taxa. It gives no ripe-harvest months or quantified yield.
items.draft: Imyuziyam idwelisa i-M. nigra njengelinywayo kumazantsi eAfrika kwaye ihlula ii-Morus ezifakwe emhlabeni. Ayinikezi nyanga zokuvuna ezivuthiweyo okanye isivuno esilinganisiweyo.
items.backtranslation: The museum lists M. nigra as grown in southern Africa and separates Morus put in the ground. It gives no months of harvesting ripe ones or estimated yield.
items.corrected: Imyuziyam idwelisa i-M. nigra njengelinywayo kumazantsi eAfrika kwaye ihlula ii-Morus ezisele zikhula zodwa. Ayinikezi nyanga zokuvuna ezivuthiweyo okanye isivuno esilinganisiweyo.

items.key: The original PROTA account dates flowering and fruiting but does not date ripening. SANBI describes red to dark-purple ripe berries without ripe picking months. The November–March observation is retained as southern African phenology; local food-ready picking months remain unknown.
items.draft: Ingxelo yoqobo ye-PROTA ibhala imihla yokuqhakaza nokuqhama kodwa ayibhali imihla yokuvuthwa. I-SANBI ichaza amaberry avuthiweyo abomvu ukuya kububomvu obumnyama ngaphandle kweenyanga zokuvuna ezivuthiweyo. Ukuqwalaselwa kukaNovemba–Matshi kugcinwe njengexesha lokuqhama laseMazantsi eAfrika; iinyanga zasekuhlaleni zokuvuna ezilungele ukutyiwa zisakwaziwa.
items.backtranslation: Original PROTA report records flowering and fruiting dates but not ripening dates. SANBI describes ripe berries red to dark red without months of harvesting ripe ones. The observation of November-March is kept as fruiting time of southern Africa; local months of harvesting ripe ones still unknown.
items.corrected: Ingxelo yoqobo ye-PROTA ibhala imihla yokuqhakaza nokuqhama kodwa ayibhali imihla yokuvuthwa. items.key: The primary study tested South African grown pod material, including those named cultivars and an unknown one, and developed food products. This is food-part evidence, not a regional maturity/yield trial. University full-text handle returned HTTP 403 during checking.
items.draft: Uvavanyo oluphambili lwavavanya izinto ze-pod ezikhuliswe eMzantsi Afrika, kubandakanya ezo ndidi zibizwe ngamagama nenye engaziwayo, kwaye lwaphuhlisa iimveliso zokutya. Obu bubungqina benxalenye yokutya, hayi uvavanyo lokuvuthwa/lwesivuno lwengingqi. Isibambi sombhalo opheleleyo we-yunivesithi sibuyise i-HTTP 403 ngexesha lokuhlola.
items.backtranslation: The main trial tested pod items grown in South Africa, including those named types and one unknown, and developed food products. This is evidence of the edible part, not a regional ripeness/yield trial. The full-text university holder returned HTTP 403 during checking.
items.corrected: Uvavanyo oluphambili lwavavanya izinto ze-pod ezikhuliswe eMzantsi Afrika, kubandakanya ezo ndidi zibizwe ngamagama nenye engaziwayo, kwaye lwaphuhlisa iimveliso zokutya. Obu bubungqina benxalenye yokutya, hayi uvavanyo lokuvuthwa/lwesivuno lwengingqi. Ikhonkco lombhalo opheleleyo we-yunivesithi libuyise i-HTTP 403 ngexesha lokuhlola.

items.key: The same source reports poison in seeds, bark, wood and roots. Guava-like fruit appearance is not evidence of edible fruit.
items.draft: Umthombo ofanayo uxela ityhefu kwiimbewu, igxolo, izinki nengcambu. Ukubonakala kweziqhamo ezifana nejamu akubungqina bokuba iziqhamo ziyatyeka.
items.backtranslation: The same source reports poison in seeds, bark, thorns(?) and root. Appearance of fruits like jam is not evidence that fruits are edible.
items.corrected: Umthombo ofanayo uxela ityhefu kwiimbewu, igxolo, umthi nengcambu. Ukubonakala kweziqhamo ezifana ne-guava akubungqina bokuba iziqhamo ziyatyeka.

items.key: The sweet, astringent ripe fruit is documented as edible, ripening February–May. This very slow-growing arid western tree has no quantified first crop age or food kg benchmark.
items.draft: Isiqhamo esivuthiweyo esimnandi, esinomhlophe, sibhalwe njengesityiwayo, sivuthwa kuFebruwari–Meyi. Lo mthi wasentshona oyomileyo okhula ngokucotha kakhulu awunabudala bokuqala sesityalo olulinganisiweyo okanye umlinganiselo wokutya we-kg.
items.backtranslation: Sweet, white ripe fruit, written as edible, ripens February-May. This very slow-growing dry western tree has no estimated first age of planting or food estimate in kg.
items.corrected: Isiqhamo esivuthiweyo esimnandi, esinokuqina emlonyeni (astringent), sibhalwe njengesityiwayo, sivuthwa kuFebruwari–Meyi. Lo mthi wasentshona oyomileyo okhula ngokucotha kakhulu awunabudala bokuqala sesityalo olulinganisiweyo okanye umlinganiselo wokutya we-kg.

items.key: This explicit caution prevents routine household-food forecasting. Sporadic all-year fruiting is not promoted to an edible-food availability calendar.
items.draft: Esi silumkiso esicacileyo sithintela uqikelelo oluqhelekileyo lokutya kwekhaya. Ukuqhama okungeneno lonyaka wonke akuphuhliswa kube yikhalenda yokufumaneka kokutya okutyiwayo.
items.backtranslation: This clear warning prevents the usual estimate of home food. Fruiting not here all year is not developed into a calendar of availability of edible food.
items.corrected: Esi silumkiso esicacileyo sithintela uqikelelo oluqhelekileyo lokutya kwekhaya. Ukuqhama ngamaxesha athile unyaka wonke akuphuhliswa kube yikhalenda yokufumaneka kokutya okutyiwayo.

items.backtranslation: This is an old one-hectare financial example; it gives no matching kg per tree or estimated biological ripening curve. No financial value or recipes of a barrel for killing(?) discarded clothes.

items.key: Use clean runners and match the variety and production system to the area. Reliable irrigation and disease control matter.
